<b>It edits your files.</b> Claude chang: It edits your files. Claude changes schematic, board and library files directly. Keep your projects in git or keep backups.
<b>Your data goes to Anthropic.</b> Your: Your data goes to Anthropic. Your messages and the project files Claude reads are processed by Anthropic under your own Claude account and its terms.
<b>Nothing goes to METU Power Lab</b> un: Nothing goes to METU Power Lab unless you send it: library pull requests and problem reports, which you review before submitting. The panel has no analytics.
<b>Confidential work:</b> don't use it o: Confidential work: don't use it on designs your NDA or employer doesn't allow you to share with an AI service.
